scheme_name: Nirman Shramik Jeevan va Bhavishya Suraksha Yojana
other_conditions: The applicant must be registered as a beneficiary with the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
The applicant must have a savings bank account in their name.
The applicant must be eligible for membership under Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY), Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY) and Atal Pension Yojana (APY).
The applicant must provide consent to their bank for the deduction of premium/contribution from their savings account.
The applicant must have gotten the annual premium/contribution amount deducted from their savings account.
benefits_summary: Provides reimbursement of insurance premiums (PMSBY, PMJJBY) and pension contributions (APY) for registered construction workers.
documents_required: Bank passbook showing proof of premium deduction
Proof of full premium deduction from bank account
Proof of contribution deduction from bank account
